start.title: [TODO:ar] The Voice from Above
start.text:
[TODO:ar] A voice fills the sky.
"Noah — build an ark. A flood is coming."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The voice fades. But the weight in your chest remains.
[TODO:ar] Your voice trembles, but the words are true.
[TODO:ar] No answer comes. Only the command remains.

mockery.title: [TODO:ar] Voices of the Crowd
mockery.text:
[TODO:ar] Villagers gather, laughing.
"A boat? Here? You are mad, old man."

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your words only feed their mockery.
[TODO:ar] Their laughter fades behind your steady hands.
[TODO:ar] They turn their backs. You are alone in faith.

building.title: [TODO:ar] Cypress and Pitch
building.text:
[TODO:ar] Years of sweat. Wood splits. Pitch seals.
Your back aches, but the ark rises.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Rest a while, the work is endless
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Doubt creeps in with the silence.
[TODO:ar] Each plank is a prayer. Each beam, a promise.

ark_done.title: [TODO:ar] It Stands Finished
ark_done.text:
[TODO:ar] The ark towers above you.
Your family gathers, silent before the wood.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Pride poisons the work. You catch yourself.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Thank God for the strength given
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your knees bend. The work was never yours alone.

animals.title: [TODO:ar] Two by Two
animals.text:
[TODO:ar] Creatures come from every land.
Lions beside lambs. Eagles at your feet.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Fear blinds you. God sent every one.
[TODO:ar] They walk past you in peace, as if they always knew.

boarding.title: [TODO:ar] The Door Closes
boarding.text:
[TODO:ar] Your family is inside. The animals settle.
God Himself shuts the door.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Run back out to warn them again
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The door is sealed. The choice has been made.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Hold your wife's hand and wait
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Together. Whatever comes — together.

storm.title: [TODO:ar] The Heavens Open
storm.text:
[TODO:ar] Rain crashes like nothing seen before.
The deep bursts. The world drowns.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The sound swallows your cry.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Trust that God is just and merciful
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You bow your head. The ark holds.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Try to pull strangers from the water
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The door is sealed. There is nothing to be done.

inside.title: [TODO:ar] Forty Days
inside.text:
[TODO:ar] The ark rocks. The animals breathe.
Days blur. Only the creak of wood remains.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Purpose holds the darkness at bay.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Sit alone and let despair grow
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The silence presses on you. Faith dims.

dove.title: [TODO:ar] The Dove Returns
dove.text:
[TODO:ar] You release a dove. Hours pass.
It comes back — an olive leaf in its beak.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Even now, doubt fights to hold you.
[TODO:ar] Tears fall on the small green leaf. Hope is real.

dry_land.title: [TODO:ar] Earth Beneath Your Feet
dry_land.text:
[TODO:ar] The door opens. Sun spills in.
You step onto warm, living mud.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Rush to claim the new land
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The land was never yours to claim.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Kneel and build an altar to God
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The first stone is for the One who saved you.

covenant.title: [TODO:ar] The Rainbow
covenant.text:
[TODO:ar] A rainbow arcs across the sky.
"Never again. This is my covenant with you."
